I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed the Linden rollout at Marrow Fieldworks has a 15 August deadline and that there's nothing to do yet.

It's 14 October now, so 15 August this year has already passed. I said I'm taking it to mean 15 August 2027 and asked him to correct me if that's wrong.

I didn't take any other action, and the message didn't include anything private or financial.
